sentences.en: Anna wants a hat.
She goes to a shop.
In the shop, she sees a hat.
"I like this hat," she says.
She takes the hat. But the hat is big, so big.
sentences.ru: Она берёт шляпу. Но шляпа большая, очень большая.

sentences.en: "I want a small hat," says Anna.
A man gives Anna a small hat.
"This is good!" says Anna.
A little mouse is here.
A cat sees the mouse.
The mouse runs.
The cat runs and runs.
The mouse runs to a hole.
The mouse goes in the hole.
The cat looks at the hole.
"Where is the mouse?" says the cat. "I cannot see it."
sentences.ru: «Где мышь? — говорит кошка. — Я её не вижу.»

sentences.en: Anna sees a window.
The window is not open.
A boy is at the window.
"Hey, boy! Can you open the window?" says Anna.
sentences.ru: «Эй, мальчик! Ты можешь открыть окно?» — говорит Анна.

sentences.en: The boy opens the window.
"Thank you," says Anna.
"Now I can see you!" says the boy.
Ben's mother makes soup.
The soup is hot.
"Be good, Ben. Do not eat it now!" says Mother.
sentences.ru: «Будь умницей, Бен. Не ешь пока!» — говорит мама.

sentences.en: Ben looks at the soup. He wants to eat.
sentences.ru: Бен смотрит на суп. Ему хочется есть.

sentences.en: Ben takes some soup. "It is hot!" he says.
sentences.ru: Бен берёт немного супа. «Он горячий!» — говорит он.

sentences.en: His mother says, "You see? The soup is hot!"
Now Ben can eat. The soup is good.
sentences.ru: Теперь Бен может есть. Суп хорош.

sentences.en: Tom looks at the clock.
"What time is it?" he says.
The clock says it is late.
"I am late!" says Tom.
Tom runs and runs.
Tom comes to the door. A man is at the door.
sentences.ru: Том подбегает к двери. У двери стоит мужчина.

sentences.en: "You are not late," says the man. "The clock is not right."
sentences.ru: «Вы не опаздываете, — говорит мужчина. — Часы не правильные.»

sentences.en: "Good," says Tom.
Kate wants to drink some tea.
She takes a cup.
She gets tea in the cup.
The tea is hot. "Hot, hot, hot!" says Kate.
sentences.ru: Чай горячий. «Горячо, горячо, горячо!» — говорит Кейт.

sentences.en: She looks at the tea. Now the tea is good.
sentences.ru: Она смотрит на чай. Теперь чай в самый раз.

sentences.en: "I like tea," says Kate.
She drinks the tea.
